Apple's September event is fast approaching, with the date expected to be announced next week. Here are over a dozen new Apple products on the horizon, most of which are expected to debut at the September event.

Here's everything new from Apple that could debut at the September event or shortly after

Apple's annual September event is the company's biggest product showcase of the year. While there are always a few surprises, new iPhone and Apple Watch models are almost guaranteed to make an appearance in September.

Here's what we expect this year:

Beyond these sure bets, another likely addition is a new pair of AirPods with infrared cameras, possibly to be called AirPods Pro 4.

Apple frequently unveils new AirPods at its September event, as they're marketed as iPhone accessories. And this week, a video leaked from macOS 26.7 gave us our first look at this long-rumored product.

Additionally, four new Apple Home products are reportedly launching as early as next month:

These ten products are the most likely to launch in September. But other possibilities include an OLED iPad mini, a home security camera, and possibly even new Macs — though the latter is more likely to arrive in October.

Which upcoming Apple product are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments.
